name: Super Vehicroid - Stealth Union (Retro Formats)
desc: "Truckroid" + "Expressroid" + "Drillroid" + "Stealthroid"When this card attacks, its original ATK is halved until the end of the Damage Step. During battle between this attacking card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. Once per turn, you can select 1 monster you control, except a Machine-Type monster, and equip it to this card. While equipped by this effect, this card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

cdb_provenance.detail: type, atk, def, level, race, attribute and setcode are copied from the row for the modern card (3897065) in cards.cdb at the ignis-babelcdb revision pinned in data/sources.json. They are NOT independently checked against a period printing: a stat change between the period card and the modern one would not be reproduced. category (a client search filter, not gameplay) is left 0 rather than copied. ot is 8 (SCOPE_ILLEGAL) as for every historical-implementation row upstream.

authorship.note: Written from the record's period text and the ocgcore Lua API, not derived from any Project Ignis CardScripts file, whose licence is AGPL-3.0-or-later (ProjectIgnis/CardScripts COPYING at the ignis-cardscripts pin). Round 029 investigation; a derived script would need an owner licensing decision.

not_reproduced: The record's period text says "select 1 monster you control, except a Machine-Type monster", without "face-up". The script only selects face-up monsters. Whether a face-down monster could be selected in the period is not established by the record's sources.

"Select" is implemented as targeting (EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET) and "once per turn" as a soft once per turn (SetCountLimit(1) on the effect); how the period rules applied either to this effect is not established by the record's sources.

The halving of the original ATK when this card attacks is a continuous effect at the attack declaration, not a chainable trigger. A period reading in which a player could respond to it is not reproduced and not tested.

The Fusion Summon procedure uses the engine's standard fusion-material procedure with the four named materials (fusion substitutes allowed). The engine tests place the card on the field directly, so the Summon itself is not exercised.

The equipped monster follows the engine's default equip rules (it goes to the Graveyard when this card leaves the field; control changes and negation are not modelled). Only equip, the ATK halving, piercing damage and attacking every opposing monster once are tested.
The card row's statline is copied from the modern row and not checked against the period printing.
